entries.thesis: The 2026-10-26 SOXX rebound does not yet validate a medium-term recovery, Meta launched $35bn equity-linked offerings and only planned up to $60bn ATM, and Brazil's severe local selloff did not establish a US-wide funding shock. With current judgment archive ERROR and unverified new ETF structure/AUM/fees/spreads, no new ETF purchase or daily allocation change is supported.
entries.counterevidence: SOXX rose 2.85% against SPY 0.71%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rebounded around 2.8%, Meta's planned equity funding may sustain data-center investment, and US major stock indices advanced despite Brazil's shock.
entries.invalidation: Revisit when the corrected judgment archive is rerun successfully, Meta financing prices on orderly terms, semiconductor issuers independently verify new orders, shipments and cash conversion, SOXX maintains positive SPY-relative strength, and US IG/HY credit conditions, ETF AUM/fees/spreads/holdings/valuation support a superior new candidate.
entries.revisit_trigger: Reassess broad no-new-candidate judgment after 5, 10 and 20 NYSE trading sessions with dated ETF, issuer, macro and funding evidence; do not score a MARKET record as a ticker return prediction.

entries.thesis: BUG cybersecurity ETF showed +15.77% over 5 and +15.31% over 21 NYSE sessions (+14.78pp against SPY over 21), above rising 20-day and 50-day technical levels. New positive watch for a 2-6-week pullback and stabilization near $49.9-50.5, with volume and SPY-relative confirmation, not a current buy call. Fund liquidity, AUM, fee and spread pass baseline checks.
entries.counterevidence: The 5-session +15.77% run creates chase/reversal risk; current volume ratio 0.954 does not confirm an accelerating breakout. Fund constituent valuations/P-E were not independently verified, and FOMC rate/earnings gaps or a cybersecurity sector repricing could undermine the theme; HACK overlaps in top holdings.
entries.invalidation: No trade idea if the proposed $49.9-50.5 reference zone fails to stabilize or BUG breaks below the prior Oct 22 $47.56 reference with weak SPY-relative strength, fund liquidity/spread degrades, issuer guidance weakens, or a >2:1 risk/reward setup cannot be validated.
entries.revisit_trigger: Watch next 1-5 NYSE sessions for a non-chasing pullback and actual volume/relative strength; re-evaluate 2-6-week setup and independently compare original Oct 27 BUG $52.35 vs SPY $769.66 after 5, 10, 20 NYSE sessions; no fabricated future price.

entries.thesis: SOXX rose 3.91% on the 2026-10-27 US session, 3.35pp above SPY, and 6.87% over the preceding two sessions. New tactical two-way research watch: possible 1-5-session pullback-and-recovery scenario around $500-505 with independently confirmed volume/relative strength; consider reversal failure below $491.83. Not a current buy/sell call and existing medium-term caution remains.
entries.counterevidence: Trailing 21-session SOXX return was -8.87% and -9.40pp against SPY; under 50-day average with falling 20-day trend, volume ratio only 0.991. Broadcom financing is not current realized chip orders, NXP earnings were published after the Oct 27 market close, and FOMC/earnings gaps may defeat stops.
entries.invalidation: Conditional bullish scenario fails if close falls below $491.83 with weak SPY-relative strength, volume does not confirm or the FOMC/issuer evidence deteriorates; a sustained relative-strength recovery and independent orders/shipments/cash conversion could ease the pre-existing medium-term risk watch.
entries.revisit_trigger: Recheck 1-5 NYSE sessions for real entry/exit conditions and FOMC gap risk; independently compare original Oct 27 SOXX $511.06 vs SPY $769.66 after 5, 10, and 20 NYSE sessions when actual dated closes exist; no pre-known outcomes.
